description: The vocabulary bank's cards, sorts, filters and reveal; the grammar tab; grammar-weakness analysis; the learning profile and which quest records its history holds (learningHistory, PL.core-learning-profile-history) (src/language-learning/bank-profile.ts).
comparison: exact, object key sets included (a key TypeScript leaves undefined is absent); an unknown op or step is an error, never a skip

cases.name: cards: by mastery (mastered first, stable within a band), categories in first-seen order, untagged as general
cards: A-Z by code unit (capitals first, accents after)
cards: most recent first, a tie keeps book order
cards: most used (right uses plus encounters) first
cards: review puts the due words first (oldest first), marks them Review!
cards: one category, capped at one, revealed on hover at B1
cards: the general category; click at C1
cards: an empty bank
reveal: inline always, hover on gaze or select, click on select
grammar: the tab, weaknesses by priority, stats and strong patterns
cases.note: Weak: ≥ 3 attempts at ≥ 500‰ errors. Priority = rate × 50 + min(25, log2(errors + 1) × 8) + min(25, log2(attempts + 1) × 6), thousandths, floor of each. Strong: ≥ 3 attempts, errors under 1/5, ≥ 5 right.

cases.name: grammar: a stricter threshold, a cap of two, and improvement against a previous snapshot
cases.note: Improved is a rate more than 100‰ below the previous one: plural 500 vs 650 is improved, word order 1000 vs 1000 is not, gender 100 vs 200 is not (exactly 100 below).

cases.name: tables: the log2 tables weakness priority reads, in thousandths
profile: categories, skills, weak and strong, unexplored, totals
cases.note: Weak category: ≥ 2 tries and under half done; strong: ≥ 2 tries and ≥ 4/5 done. Skills are (mean − 1) / 4 of the 1..5 scores in thousandths (500 with no score); weak under 400, strong from 700. The latest band is the newest assessment that has one.

cases.name: profile: nothing played
history: an active, in-progress, available or unstatused quest is not in it
cases.note: Finished only: completed, failed, abandoned. The active conversation quest is no attempt, so conversation stays unexplored and vocabulary counts one try (contrast "profile: categories…", where learningProfile is handed an active record and counts it).

cases.name: history: a non-language quest is kept as its own category
cases.note: Every quest type is kept (Babylon's behaviour, U101(4)): combat forms a category, is strong at 2 of 2, counts in the totals, and is never one of unexplored's twelve language categories.

cases.name: history: a record with no questType counts in the totals and in no category
cases.note: An absent, empty or non-string questType is kept with questType null; an id that is not a string becomes ''; a completedAtMs that is not an integer ms is null.

cases.name: history: repeated attempts are the records the host holds
cases.note: Nothing is merged by id and attemptCount is not read: r1, retried in place three times, is one completed row; the two records of r2 (failed, then completed) are two rows, so navigation is 1 of 3 done (weak) and its last attempt is the newest of the three.

cases.name: history: abandoned and failed count the same (abandoned)
cases.note: An abandoned record stays abandoned in the history and the profile counts it exactly as a failure: this case and its twin differ only in that status, and their profiles are equal.

cases.name: history: abandoned and failed count the same (failed)
cases.note: An abandoned record stays abandoned in the history and the profile counts it exactly as a failure: this case and its twin differ only in that status, and their profiles are equal.

cases.name: history: completedAtMs is the record's own integer ms; completedAt is never read
cases.note: Only the record's completedAtMs, kept when it is an integer (0 and a negative integer are kept), else null; no Date.parse. completedAt (Babylon's QuestRecord.completedAt, core's Quest.completedAt: an ISO string or a number) is not read, even with no completedAtMs, and loses to it when both are there. k1 is a record as core's lifecycle holds it (no completion time): null, counted as 0 in lastAttemptedAtMs, so vocabulary's last attempt is 0 and grammar's is k6's 0 against k7's -5.

cases.name: history: a quest's difficulty is not read (failed quests beginner)
cases.note: The profile weighs every finished record alike, whatever its difficulty (Babylon's buildLearningProfile never read QuestRecord.difficulty), and the row does not carry it. This case and its twin swap the difficulties of the failed and the completed records (and one twin leaves a difficulty off): their profiles are equal, and so are their histories.

cases.name: history: a quest's difficulty is not read (failed quests advanced)
cases.note: The profile weighs every finished record alike, whatever its difficulty (Babylon's buildLearningProfile never read QuestRecord.difficulty), and the row does not carry it. This case and its twin swap the difficulties of the failed and the completed records (and one twin leaves a difficulty off): their profiles are equal, and so are their histories.

cases.name: history: records straight from core's quest lifecycle carry the completedAtMs their completing step stamped, so lastAttemptedAtMs is that time, not 0
cases.note: The input is QuestLifecycle.quests() after the steps in LIFECYCLE_HISTORY_STEPS (systems-corpus-cases.ts), as a host hands it on: l1 completed by a use_word at 1794823200000 and l2 by a talk at 1794823260000, so vocabulary's last attempt is 1794823260000; l3 (grammar) is still active, so the lifecycle hands it on with no completedAtMs (the stale one its input carried is not read) and it is not in the history; l4 (pronunciation) completed by a step with no atMs, so its row has null, counted as 0 (U118(6)). The difficulties (l1 advanced, l2 beginner) are not read and not in the rows (U124(2)).
